title: Identification of Calculous Pyonephrosis by CT-Based Radiomics and Deep Learning.
summary: CT radiomics and 3D CNN classified calculous pyonephrosis in a retrospective 182-patient cohort; combined model AUC 0.967 on test data. This supports a narrow diagnostic-validation result, not clinical benefit.
